preconditions.description: The input contains exactly M + 1 lines: the first line with N and M, followed by M lines describing roads.
N and M satisfy the stated constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 100000 for w in weights)
preconditions.description: Each road's importance value is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The graph formed by the cities and roads is connected.

postconditions.description: The output is the product of the minimum cut values (separation numbers) for all unordered pairs of distinct cities, modulo 10^9 + 7.
The result correctly reflects the definition where the separation number for a pair (A, B) is the minimum sum of weights of a set of edges whose removal disconnects A from B.
